cluster: First observation only; observed <4 resets; NULL does not reset; warm up state in pre-buffer. Never replace an UNKNOWN first signal.
missing: No fill; any incomplete future window UNKNOWN, even partial observed hits. Baseline uses same per-label full-future and range-valid policies.
baseline: All range-valid 5-minute observations, not matched controls; L1 and L2 separate valid denominators.
required_metrics: FLOCK included/excluded rates and baseline lifts
secondary_rule: Compare success/failure median and rank-effect direction only. No cutoffs, combinations, or changes to primary filter.

verdict_rules.note: Operational descriptive gates fixed now, not significance claims. Discovery rates are references, never pass thresholds.
verdict_rules.REPLICATED: Both labels: >=20 successes, >=20 failures, >=3 success markets, cluster rate / same-population observation baseline >=1.5, and FLOCK-excluded lift >1 with >=3 success markets.
verdict_rules.PARTIAL: Not REPLICATED or concentrated FAILED: at least one label lift >1 with >=3 success markets and FLOCK-excluded lift >1. Insufficient sample explicitly flagged.
verdict_rules.FAILED: Neither label has such support, or both labels depend on <3 success markets or lose lift after FLOCK exclusion.
verdict_rules.no_valid_data: Do not assign performance verdict; DATA_INSUFFICIENT.

boundaries: Main periods disjoint. Buffers may overlap. Discovery post-buffer already includes Sep15 00:00-06:00 KST; declare this prior exposure. Also report predeclared exclusion of validation first6h without replacing primary period.
limitations: Retrospective historical validation, not fully prospective: freeze date Sep26 is after validation start. Do not claim the entire interval was future at policy freeze. Multiple signals/labels remain dependent.
collection: A primary same fixed 50 alts + BTC; B separate optional DB, prior-only existing 60% policy. Never reselect A after missing/delisted markets.
